test_title: PYST 145: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y. V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C. D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

Who sits at the immediate left of Y?
solution:
Given : 

 
• Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.
 
• In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.
 
• In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

Explanation :

1) V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193e94de547c3f015391709cd1f8d7fafa2987043a0818549f903ac0f1e5f3ae.png] 

2) D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594a52916b85d23450a45601f3bf856e570e8039b917cf8ec099316d690372d1.png] 

3) B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y.

After positioning B, A and Y only one position is left in row - II which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d0a6d6fbc6e80216239ce334e9275c7dd60a4a46ebfc3e7323b4e778aa9d162.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Z sits at the immediate left of Y.

Hence, **"Z"** is the correct answer.
